scenarios.name: create leaves an asset processing and classify allows it by default
classify uses analyzedOutcome and create uses queuedOutcome
a reviewer's block shows in retrieve, list, filters and events, and stops delivery
purging removes the content and the CDN refuses it
keepContentAfterProcessing keeps content until it is deleted
a key without assets:download cannot read private content
a key with assets:download reads private and age-restricted content
a public age-restricted asset is served without a grant only with ageConfirmed
a limited asset is served from its public URL like an allowed one
an idempotency key replays the first result and refuses a different request
an externalId is unique in the project
the author and the earlier posts CalmLens uses are kept until the content is removed
waitForDecision times out on a pending asset and returns a decided one
hash lists hold entries until the list is deleted
a folder with assets cannot be deleted
keyword search matches every token in any searchable field, case-insensitively, ranked like the API
filters group with parentheses, and ; binds tighter than ,
list cursors resume after the last item when assets are created or deleted between pages
enqueued events reach cursors taken before them
update changes only the fields it is given, null clears them, and externalId stays unique
move files an asset into a folder and back to the root, and refuses an unknown folder
an uploaded asset has no children, and listing an unknown asset's children is not found
retry processes a failed asset again only while it still has content
explain needs a decision, and rerun moderates again unless reviewed or the content is gone
deleting content twice keeps the first removal, and a deleted asset is gone
batch removes content and deletes assets, and an unknown or malformed ID refuses the whole batch
a reviewer's purge records content-removed before asset.purged
events page by limit until hasMore is false, with a default limit of 50 and a maximum of 100
list pages default to 10 items, accept 1 to 100, and a cursor only continues its own query
search uses at most 8 distinct tokens, returns 10 results by default and refuses out-of-range input

scenarios.name: waitForDecision reports the asset's statuses when it times out and refuses a negative timeout
multipart parts arrive in order, need 5 MiB until the last, and finish with the saved queue mode
multipart image totals must be 10 to 20 MiB, and parts must add up to a declared total
a failed request frees its idempotency key, keys are 1 to 255 printable characters, and surrounding spaces are trimmed
injected failures fail only the request they target, once each, and change nothing
ensureLenses saves new lenses, returns unchanged ones and needs a greater version for changes
folders are unique among siblings, list in name order with their ancestors, and search
moving folders refuses cycles and duplicate names, and a folder with subfolders is not empty
an assets:download grant on a folder covers its subfolders only with includeSubfolders
a public image's placeholder is served whatever its moderation, and refused once purged or removed
originals carry the CDN's cache tag and protection headers, and images an ETag and Expires
